name: Corey Taylor 2004 Mask
teaser:
"I fight for the unconventional
My right, and it's unconditional
I can only be as real as I can"
description_html:
One of my favorite slipknot masks from the Subliminal Verses era of slipknot. Any criticism will be taken seriously as long as it’s constructive. Hope you enjoy!!

Huge thanks and credits to the WTT team for letting me bounce stuff off of them and for the help they gave as well as the codebase they let me use, RheddElbozo for being a bitch and guiding me through this process of modding (as well as some code)
